newsitem.title: SYRIA: France's Chirac condemns Damascus blast.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac condemns Damascus blast.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac has condemned the bombing of a bus in central Damascus that killed nine people and wounded 44 as an "ugly action".
Chirac's remarks, which also expressed his sympathy for the families of the victims, were contained in a telegram he sent to Syrian President Hafez al-Assad after the New Year's eve blast.
"I received with deep sorrow news about the aggression which saddened your country and killed several people and wounded many others," said an Arabic version of Chirac's cable obtained by Reuters.
"France has condemned this ugly action...France resists in all occasions terrorism," Chirac said.
The French president expressed his "sincere condolences" and requested Assad to convey his "full sympathy to families of the victims".
Syria announced the blast on Thursday and accused agents of the Israeli intelligence service Mossad of responsiblity. Israel denied the charge.
